3. Construct Scalar Field
Fields are used by Wasp to drive aggregations, placing new components by following
higher gradient values in the field. Field can be initialised by creating a point grid with a defined
resolution within a given bounding box.
Different Grasshopper techniques can be used to generate custom fields fit to particualt purposes
(eg. geometry reconstruction, structural performance, environmental data, attractor geometries).

NB: please be careful with setting the FieldPts resolution. If you set a very low resolution and your 
Boundaries are very large, you will quickly create millions of points, hence slowing down the whole
Grasshopper definition.
